title: The Lotus Sutra (Fall Class Part 5)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk explores the concept of spiritual growth and awakening, encouraging listeners to reflect on their own limitations and desires. It introduces the idea of becoming more aware of one's own potential and how this awareness relates to the Buddhist concept of Bodhisattvas, who strive to awaken others. Nomon Tim Burnett shares parables that illustrate the importance of skillful means in teaching the Dharma, highlighting the need for nuanced approaches that balance wisdom with compassion and understanding.
